## Project Structure

```
├── slides.qmd                 # Main presentation slides
├── abstract.qmd              # Conference abstract
├── assets/
│   ├── figures/              # Figures and charts
│   ├── images/               # Photos and graphics
│   └── logos/                # Institutional logos
├── handouts/
│   ├── summary.qmd           # One-page summary
│   └── references.qmd        # Extended bibliography
└── supplementary/
    ├── full-paper.qmd        # Complete research paper (if available)
    ├── appendices.qmd        # Additional analyses
    └── data-tables.qmd       # Detailed data tables
```

## Building the Presentation

### Create Slides
```bash
# Generate presentation slides
quarto render slides.qmd

# Create handout materials
quarto render handouts/summary.qmd
```

### Output Formats
- **HTML:** Interactive slides with transitions
- **PDF:** Printable slides for backup
- **PPTX:** PowerPoint format for editing

```bash
# Specific formats
quarto render slides.qmd --to revealjs
quarto render slides.qmd --to pdf
quarto render slides.qmd --to pptx
```
